name: @preflight/eval
description: Preflight eval harness — corpus runner (self-generated / blind / replay, reported separately per S18.3), capability-honest adapter (NOT-RUNNABLE-YET, never a faked verdict), fixture generator (S18.1 self-growing loop off the shadow log). Zero runtime deps, node:test, same native type-stripping build as @preflight/core.
//design-choices: S18.3 / TEST-ENG VETO: catch rate and false-block rate are computed and rendered PER
CORPUS ONLY. There is no code path that produces a blended number; report.ts has no
cross-corpus aggregation and the tests assert its absence.
NO-SILENT-CAPS: where the blind schema uses capabilities @preflight/core does not
implement yet (card verdicts, screen observations, streaming, derived time, amounts,
non-entity referents, ...), the adapter scores the case NOT-RUNNABLE-YET with the
missing capability NAMED and COUNTED — never adapted into a fake pass or fake catch.
DETERMINISM: no Date.now in any library code path. The run timestamp is a required
CLI argument; the self-corpus generator pins the shadow clock to 0.
//run-model: Run-from-source CLI/harness (imports @preflight/core by relative source path, resolves corpora via import.meta.url). `build` typechecks src+tools (tsc --noEmit); it deliberately does NOT emit dist/ (that would break the relative core import and corpora resolution). Tests are verified by execution.
